utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, I’m glad it’s starting to come together. If I hear anything new about the repair drive location, I’ll pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — appreciate you keeping an ear out. We’ve still got the fence panel, the cracked walkway, and the porch light to handle, and we’re short on screws, tape, and a good wrench.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m on it, Mara — I’ll keep my ears open for the location and spread the word if I hear where folks should drop things off. Sounds like you could really use those supplies, too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Jules — I just need a quick heads-up on who’s coming and any tools already set aside. I’ll swing by later and check in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll round up the list of who’s coming and see what tools are already set aside, then I’ll send you a quick update before you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks. Just send the update when you have it, and I’ll check in later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ve got the repair drive details and you’re spreading the word, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — I’ve got the repair drive details, and I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time does the repair drive need me there? I can work it around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Late morning works best—around 10 should be fine. If that’s tight, I can make it work after pickup instead.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 should work for me — I can swing by before pickup. Thanks, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and label the boxes. Just let me know what time you need me there, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you send me the pickup timing and who’s handling the rides? Once I know that, I can see if I can make it and help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll check the pickup timing and who’s handling the rides, then send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. I’ll get the repair drive details ready and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive around the block and remind folks to bring whatever they can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll get the repair drive details ready and keep them simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still good to bring screws, duct tape, and a box of gloves. What’s most needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane — those are all useful. If you hear the plan and timing, let me know, and I’ll bring whatever else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll ask around and pass along the plan and timing as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring a hammer and some screwdrivers for the repair drive. Just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’s super helpful. If you hear the time or any other details about the repair drive, could you send them my way?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the time and any updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We still need to fix the loose fence panel by the alley, patch the cracked walkway near the mailbox, and check the porch light at the corner house. Which one should we start with?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Let’s start with the fence panel by the alley — that seems like the easiest one to knock out first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — I’ll start on the fence panel by the alley, and we can move to the walkway after that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — screws and tape would be a big help. If you can find that wrench too, I’ll keep your name on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and if you can make it, bring a friend too!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep the supply list going and let folks know we still need a wrench.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll bring the screws and tape, and I’ll look for a wrench too. Just let me know what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’m still headed to the repair drive and keeping track of where everything goes. If you find the wrench, set it aside and I’ll note the location when I get back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll set the wrench aside if I find it and keep the screws and tape ready. Just tell me where to put things when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: All right, I’m here when you do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep folks posted, and it’d help if you spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. I’ll spread the word and let people know it’s on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still happy to help, but I need the pickup timing and a clear contact first so we don’t lose track of anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll share the pickup timing and a clear contact so nothing gets lost. We’re fixing the loose fence panel by the alley, patching the cracked walkway near the mailbox, and checking the porch light at the corner house.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — once you send the timing and contact, I can see whether I can make it and help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got the screws and tape ready, and I’ll keep an eye out for a wrench too. Just let me know what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great — screws are still the most urgent, and gloves would help too. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can bring the screws, and I’ll see if I can find a pair of gloves too. Thanks for spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We need to fix the loose fence panel by the alley, patch the cracked walkway near the mailbox, and check the porch light at the corner house. Do you want me to focus on one of those first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let’s start with the loose fence panel by the alley, then we can move on to the walkway and porch light. I’ll help coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — I’ll start with the loose fence panel by the alley. After that, we can move to the cracked walkway near the mailbox and the porch light at the corner house.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m still hearing the repair drive is moving along nicely, and a few more hands would really help. If I spot the exact location, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — if you spot where it’s set up, just let me know. I can stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know the moment I spot the setup location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That should cover it for now — thanks, Gus. I’ll be ready when you bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Mina — I’ll bring the hammer and screwdrivers by soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Gus. I’ll keep an eye out for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. If you can help spread the word, that’d be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. I’ll keep that in mind and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I really appreciate it. If anyone asks, just point them to the Sunday community center update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: All right, I’ll be here when you do.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — and if you see folks around, could you mention the repair drive and that any help they can bring would be great?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll mention it to anyone I see.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details right now, and I can keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out and let folks know to bring any help they can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Ira — the more folks we can rally, the better. I’ll get those details out and keep everyone posted!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it. I’ll get the repair drive details ready and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — just send me the time and I’ll help sort the donations and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send the time over soon, and I’ll keep the repair drive details simple.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — screws and tape would be a big help, and a wrench would be great if you can find one too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can bring screws, tape, and I’ll look for a wrench too — just tell me what time you need me there, and I’ll work it around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be wonderful — if you can come by around 3 PM, we’ll be in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for this weekend, right? Who’s handling the pickups?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on this weekend. I can handle the pickups — send me the addresses and times.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming: you’ve got the pickups, and I should send you the addresses and times, right?
